items.title: Sonesta Cuts Jobs as a $2 Billion Bid Puts Many of Its Best Hotels in Play
items.snippet: Skift Take: Service Properties Trust hired Sonesta to operate 68 of the hotels it owns. But an unsolicited offer for those hotels has created uncertainty. Meanwhile, Sonesta has cut corporate staff. Sonesta began laying off employees last Friday, according to an employee who spoke anonymously to Skift and at least nine LinkedIn posts.

items.title: Handling 800+ Calls a Month With Canary's AI Voice at Hotel Zephyr
items.snippet: Hotel Zephyr's GM details how Canary's AI Voice handled 800+ calls in a single month, cutting hold times and freeing staff, while Dynamic Upsells generate $130K in annual ancillary revenue.

items.title: Alaska Airlines Expands Seattle Long-Haul Network With Osaka and Tahiti
items.snippet: Alaska is adding Osaka and Tahiti from Seattle in 2027, using Hawaiian A330s to extend its Pacific reach while reviving a Tahiti market another carrier recently abandoned.

items.title: Richard Cooke joins Dorchester Collection to head the Hotel Bel-Air
items.snippet: Dorchester Collection appoints Richard Cooke as general manager of the Hotel Bel-Air in Los Angeles, effective 1 January 2027. He comes from Rocco Forte Hotels, where he led operations in the UK and Northern Europe.

items.title: India hotel sector records growth amid rising supply pipeline
items.snippet: India’s hospitality sector recorded growth in occupancy, room rates and revenue during 2025/26, even as performance varied across cities and a substantial development pipeline raised questions about future supply absorption. These findings are from the 2026 Indian Hospitality Trends & Opportunities Report by Hotelivate-Savills, which examines the country’s hotel market and emerging investment opportunities.

items.title: India plans airfare caps only during extraordinary situations
items.snippet: The Centre has clarified that it does not intend to interfere with market-driven airfare pricing, despite upcoming rules under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024. A government official told The Economic Times that airfares would continue to be determined by demand and supply, with intervention reserved for extraordinary circumstances such as natural calamities or major disruptions.

items.title: Batam’s first integrated resort, Opus Bay, to open in December 2026
items.snippet: Opus Bay, Batam’s first integrated resort estate, is scheduled to begin phased operations in December 2026, introducing a new hospitality, leisure and lifestyle destination approximately 45 minutes by ferry from Singapore. Developed around the concept of ‘A City within a City’, the waterfront development will combine accommodation, retail, dining and recreational facilities within a single destination.

items.title: Minor Hotels to bring Anantara Retreats to India with luxury wellness resort in Darjeeling
items.snippet: Minor Hotels has partnered with JK Urbanscapes Developers Limited (JKUDL), part of the JK Organisation, to develop Anantara Retreat Darjeeling Hills, a 70-key luxury wellness retreat at Tindharia Tea Estate in West Bengal. Scheduled to open in 2031, the property will mark the debut of Anantara Retreats in India.

items.title: NHCC serves up a taste of Bengal with Bhuri Bhoj
items.snippet: For Bengalis, Durga Puja is a celebration of food and festivity, with traditional delicacies holding a place of pride alongside the rituals and pandal-hopping. From Luchi and Chholar Dal to Kosha Mangsho, Basanti Polao and Daab Chingri, food is central to the celebrations.

items.title: ixigo delivers PAT of Rs 63.42 crore in Q2 FY27 as hotels business emerges as significant growth driver
items.snippet: This is the first quarter ixigo has started disclosing hotels as a separate line of business. Hotels has emerged as ixigo’s fastest-growing line of business with GTV growth of +159 percent YoY, Revenue growth of +528 percent, with a 12 percent + gross take rate. 86 percent + of bookings came from ixigo’s own captive users.
